source_row.rationale: Assigning specific team roles during postpartum hemorrhage protocol activation reduces communication gaps and duplication of effort during this high-stress event, with significant nursing involvement in these roles.
source_row.source_detail: Purpose of Defined Team Roles in Hemorrhage Response
source_row.source_name: AWHONN — Postpartum Hemorrhage Team Role Assignment
